audience: logistics and sales teams that turn addresses into map coordinates and distances

useCases.title: Geocode a customer address
useCases.text: Turn one address into coordinates and standard address parts, or split one address line into its components.

useCases.title: Geocode a batch of addresses
useCases.text: Geocode up to 1000 addresses in one call, or turn up to 1000 latitude and longitude pairs into addresses.

useCases.title: Find the address at a point
useCases.text: Turn one latitude and longitude into the nearest address.

useCases.title: Measure distances to branches
useCases.text: Measure the driving distance and time from one origin to many destinations, or build a full distance matrix.

useCases.title: Check the results of uploaded lists
useCases.text: List the uploaded spreadsheets, read the status of one list, and download its results as CSV text.

useCases.title: Delete an old geocoding list
useCases.text: Find the list, then delete it with its results. The deletion cannot be undone.
